caption:
Part 2 of Mussolini's February 23, 1941 speech to the Blackshirts of Rome, as translated into English at the time, continuing exactly where Part 1 ended. His claims here, including about a 'Masonic, democratic, capitalistic world,' are historical record, not endorsed. Read by a synthetic voice with a vintage-radio effect, not Mussolini's. No freely licensed photos of this exact speech were found; these public-domain photos are from other occasions and are dated on screen. Music: original beat generated for this project, in the mood of a slow, dark hip-hop track.

Mussolini, Feb. 23, 1941: Part 2 📜 #history #historytok #didyouknow #education
